title: Ziplock bag organizer w/cutters to hang on wall or put in super large drawer; one door loose
text:
Ziplock bag organizer w/cutters to hang on wall or put in super large drawer; one door loose. I've reviewed and tried many of these Ziplock bag organizers and this one's roll compartments are designed differently. It is a six-compartment organizer with two compartments for a roll of plastic wrap and foil (although it can also be used for waxed paper if ignoring the labels). It comes with two cutters that I had to install in the channels simply by removing the adhesive backing and pressing in place. There are also four other compartments for different types of Ziplock bags (quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack). All compartments have their labels etched into them. The cutting strips cut well.

The bags have to be loaded through their slots, which is perfect for when it is hung on the wall. The roll area has doors. The bottom door for the plastic wrap flips down and is held by two hinges. I wish the top door for the foil did the same. Instead, that door flips open on one hinge and that hinge is loose and feels like it will fall off. This is the only reason I rated this unit 3 instead of 5 stars. I do like the way the roll is threaded down toward the cutter. This is the first unit I do not have to feed or fish through a thin slot.

Unfortunately, three screws with plastic mollies are NOT provided for hanging. However, felt circles are already affixed to the bottom to prevent the bamboo from scratching a wall or drawer and keep it from sliding around in a drawer.

Overall, this is an excellent organizer that does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets. I like the design but hate how the foil door is loose. The current price of $37.99 is on the low side of competitively priced for a six-compartment unit like this.
